SearchFormDefinition.name: SearchDefCurrencyConversion
SearchFormDefinition.Source: SELECT CURR.START_DATE, CURR.END_DATE, BE.BUSINESS_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER, BE. BUSINESS_ENTITY_NAME, CURR.FROM_CURRENCY, CURR.TO_CURRENCY, CURR.CONVERSION_RATE FROM CURRENCY CURR LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY BE ON CURR.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY = BE.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE BET ON BE.BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE_KEY = BET.BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE_KEY
